how.title: How it works
how.intro: One shirt or two hundred, it's the same three steps.
how.step1_text: Tees, hoodies, sweatshirts, sportswear, tote bags and workwear, in the colours and sizes you need.
how.step2_text: Upload a logo or design and tell us where it goes. We check it will print well.
how.step3_text: We send a proof showing your design on the garment at its real print size. Nothing is printed until you approve it. Most orders are ready in 5-7 working days after you approve. Some in-stock tees can be quicker, just ask.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Quick answers about ordering, artwork, delivery and returns. Can't find yours? Get in touch.
faq.a_minimum: No. We print one item or hundreds.
faq.q_bulk: Do you give discounts for bigger orders?
faq.a_bulk: Yes, automatically by the number of items: 10+ items 5% off, 20+ 10%, 40+ 15%, 50+ 20%.
faq.q_price: How do I get a price?
faq.a_price: Choose your garment, add your sizes and print positions, and request a quote. It's free, with no obligation.
faq.q_mix: Can I mix sizes and colours?
faq.a_mix: Yes, mixing sizes and colours is fine. Whether the bulk discount covers different garments in one order depends on the order, and your quote will show it.
faq.q_find: I can't find the garment I want.
faq.a_find: We can get thousands more styles from our suppliers. Ask us and we'll send you the full catalogue.
faq.q_business: Do you work with schools, clubs and businesses?
faq.a_business: Yes, lots. Regular customers can open an account and pay on 7-day terms.
faq.a_file: A vector file (SVG, PDF, AI or EPS) is best. A large PNG works too.
faq.q_proof: Will I see it before you print?
faq.a_proof: Yes, always. We send a proof showing the garment, position and print size. Nothing is printed until you approve it.
faq.q_design: Can you help with my design?
faq.a_design: Yes. Send what you have and we'll tidy it up or redraw it. The price depends on the work, and we'll tell you before we start.
faq.q_colour: Can you match my brand colours exactly?
faq.a_colour: We don't offer Pantone or exact colour matching. Colours on fabric can look different from your screen or brand guide.
faq.a_time: Usually 5 to 7 working days after you approve the proof and pay. Ask us if you have a deadline.
faq.a_collect: Yes, free from our shop in Leamington Spa. We'll email you when it's ready.
faq.a_cost: Delivery is free on orders over £100. Otherwise the price is shown on your quote. We deliver to UK addresses only.
faq.q_wash: How should I wash my printed garment?
faq.a_wash: Inside out, at 30°C, no tumble dry, and don't iron directly on the print.
faq.q_return: Can I return a printed item?
faq.a_return: Everything is printed to order, so we can't take items back for a change of mind. If something is faulty or wrong, we'll put it right.
faq.q_own: Can I bring my own garments to print on?
faq.a_own: Please contact us first. We don't recommend it, because there's always a risk when printing on garments we didn't supply, and we can't take responsibility for any damage.

artwork.title: How to get a sharp print
artwork.intro: Send us the best file you have and we'll check it before anything is printed. You'll always see a proof first.
artwork.vector_note: Best choice. Prints sharp at any size.
artwork.jpg_note: Fine if large, but the background will print too.
artwork.files_warning: Screenshots, social media images and logos copied from a website are usually too small to print well.
artwork.size_text: There's no fixed print size. Unless you ask for a size, we choose the best one for your design and garment, and show it on your proof.
artwork.size_guide: As a guide, your image needs about 300 pixels for every inch (2.5 cm) of print. A full front print about 28 cm wide needs about 3,300 pixels.
artwork.size_small: If your file is smaller, it may print blurry. We'll tell you before printing and suggest a fix.
artwork.tip_text: Keep text at least 5 mm tall so it's readable.
artwork.tip_outlines: In vector files, convert text to outlines so the font prints correctly.
artwork.tip_lines: Thin lines under 1 mm may not print cleanly.
artwork.tip_dark: Dark designs on dark garments may disappear. Ask us about adding an outline.
artwork.tip_colour: We don't do Pantone or exact colour matching. Colours on fabric can look different from your screen or brand guide.
artwork.methods_intro: We use two methods. We'll pick the best one for your design and garment and show it on your proof.
artwork.dtg_text: Ink printed straight into the fabric. Soft feel, great for detailed and full-colour designs on cotton.
artwork.dtf_text: Your design is printed on film and heat-pressed on. Bright and durable, works on most fabrics including polyester sportswear.
artwork.help_text: Send what you have, even a sketch or a photo of an old shirt. We can tidy it up or redraw it. The price depends on the work, and we'll tell you before we start.
artwork.send_text: Upload it when you request a quote, or email it to us.
artwork.rights_text: Only send artwork you own or have permission to use.
